judge.why: The tutor's first message gave away the full resolution (case table, 2/3, host knowledge, 100 doors) without first probing the learner, but turns 2-3 used well-targeted Socratic questions that got the learner to conclude for themselves that staying wins ~100/300 and switching ~200, though the learner never stated the host-constraint reason in their own words and the final turn was another lecture.
